title: dev.qory.runtime.tool_result
description: What the runtime gave the model as the result of a tool call, as it printed it on its standard output.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the tool call, as in its dev.qory.runtime.tool_started.

content.description: The result, the runtime's value unchanged: a string, or an array of blocks such as {"type": "text", "text": "..."}. A string is cut to its first 65536 bytes of UTF-8 at a character boundary, and an array to a JSON encoding of at most 65536 bytes, with truncated set.

is_error.description: true when the runtime reported the result as an error.

agent_id.description: The subagent this happened in, when it did not happen in the main conversation.

line.description: The number of the line of the session's standard output the record was read from, from 1, counting every line, whether it is a JSON object or not. The session sets it on an event of the output source; an event of a hook has none.

truncated.description: true when the session cut content; absent otherwise.
